sentences.en: Her emergency fund is shrinking while the salon remains closed.
sentences.zh: 她的紧急基金在储蓄所关闭的情况下正在减少。

sentences.en: The shrinking of the domestic market has been blamed on inflation.
sentences.zh: 国内市场缩小被认为是由于通货膨胀造成的。

sentences.en: Some trousers shrink when they are washed for the first time.
sentences.zh: 一些裤子第一次洗的时候会缩水。

senses.zh: 收缩；畏缩；<俚>精神病学家

mnemonic: 联想记忆：童话里喝（drink）了药水就能将身体收缩（shrink）
